patterns.rationale: Security and research references are unrelated provenance and must remain unchanged.
Security-looking terms without an explicit research or disclosure context are not presumed accurate.
Clean-room and legal references are contextual and must remain unchanged.
Provenance language is retained until an exact inaccurate reference is proven.

notes: Empty by design: inventory-only is safe before any provenance rule is reviewed. Add only exact, mechanically provable substitutions; leave uncertain references unchanged.
